cm03_intent.interpretation: Eight parent-reviewed manual intent pairs, approved before predictions. Input-only development diagnostic, not independent organizer gold, a representative holdout or a private-score estimate. Category/decision pair accuracy, normal false blocks and blocked false allows supplement the unchanged official scorer. No training or deployment.

intent_metrics.invalid_handling: Invalid or missing responses count as wrong; reported separately from valid false blocks/allows.
